FFprobe 7.1.5 — LGPL static build for macOS arm64 (Right Suite shared, decode variant)
Built: 2026-10-07 on Apple Silicon, Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2).
Recipe: crates/rightkit-ffmpeg/recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh build --variant decode --arch arm64 --tool ffprobe
configure: --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect --enable-static
           --disable-shared --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small
           --arch=arm64 --cc="clang -arch arm64"

Run-verified on the arm64 build host: -version banner/configuration, and -show_entries stream=codec_name,sample_rate on a WAV.
Reproducible: a clean second build from the same recipe/toolchain produced the identical sha256.
